name: Monitor Depricarping
implementation_notes: depricarping_record/depricarping_detail local SQLite tables in localSchema.ts unchanged by this revision (same columns/unique constraint, including downtime_minutes integer + findings free-text kept as two distinct columns) -- only the row-population pattern changed

depricarpingRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Depricarping screens (039/043/047) in one file, same convention as pressingRecordRepo.ts covering screens 038/042/046; its full unit test coverage (depricarpingRecordRepo.spec.ts, 29 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): createDraft() now inserts ONLY the header row -- the 24 pre-created depricarping_detail rows were a literal reading of the paper log-sheet mockup that wasted screen space; rows are now added one at a time by the user in Form Depricarping via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring pressingRecordRepo.ts's/threshingRecordRepo.ts's just-fixed pattern (itself mirroring cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts's cages_tipped_time pattern)

'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter redefined as a plain COUNT(*) of depricarping_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no longer filtered by 'has >=1 of 8 reading columns filled', since row existence itself is now the meaningful signal (a row only exists because the user explicitly added it); MonitorDepricarpingView.vue's counter field renamed from filledSlotCount/counter-filled-slot-count to detailRowCount/counter-detail-row-count

depricarpingOperationalTargets.ts uses the entity-catalog's own 4-column shape (parameter_metric/target_range/critical_limit/operational_consequence_justification) -- one column more than Threshing's/Pressing's 3-column shape -- UNTOUCHED by this revision

Router: route name 'monitor-depricarping' registered in router/index.ts, but StationListView.vue (screen-006, out of this 6-screen task's scope) has NOT been updated to link to it -- see known_issues, same known issue already documented for Threshing/Pressing

known_issues.description: StationListView.vue (screen-006, out of this 6-screen task's scope) has not been updated to add a Depricarping tile/link to 'monitor-depricarping' -- this screen is reachable directly by route/URL but not yet from the Station List grid. Needs a separate revision of screen-006 (shared across all 4 new-station agent runs, not owned by any single one -- Threshing's/Pressing's implement artifacts document the identical gap).

Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-depricarping.spec.ts) was originally authored following Threshing's/Pressing's e2e-spec pattern for the fixed-24-row design, then REVISED 2026-08-24 alongside this fix to seed only as many depricarping_detail rows as a real 'Tambah baris' flow would produce and assert the dynamic-grid counter/testids -- still could not be executed in this sandboxed environment against a running dev server + seeded backend, verified only by static review (syntax confirmed via `playwright test --list`).
